program.name: Body-Part Split
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: A classic four-day split: one muscle group a day, lots of sets for each.
program.about: The classic gym split, done at home: chest one day, back the next, then legs, then shoulders and arms. Each day spends all its sets on one area, so it can be worked hard and then left to recover for most of a week. Straight sets with full rests. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III slows every rep down.
